featured_reviews.name: Vivek Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ease of access:
[ ] Navigation accuracy - Navigation to this place was accurate and the location marker on maps is also correct.

[ ] Route preference - The place is visible from the main road.

[ ] Wheelchair accessibility - This place is not wheelchair accessible. It's located on the first floor of a supermarket building run by the same management.

[ ] Parking space - Limited parking space available in front of the store for both 2 and 4 wheelers.

Experience:
[ ] Space - There is an ample amount of space available inside the store.

[ ] Ambience - The lighting is good and the staff is attentive. There is a good variety of all kinds of footwear for adults and children alike.
They have a section for accessories for men (wallets and belts) as well, but the selection was too limited.

[ ] Crowd - The place was opened recently, around November 2022 and at the time of writing, the place was close to empty.

[ ] Product pricing and quality - They have footwear from most of the common brands and some local brands. The latter are also of good quality and the prices are reasonable. The staff are attentive and they also can make some size related fitting adjustments if needed (insoles, heel adjustment etc)

[ ] Verdict - This is a good alternative to shopping for footwear at malls. There is a lot of variety, there is enough space, and the staff are decent. Pricing is also competitive.
